datasets.name: 90ee599e
queryLines:
SELECT
    p.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, p.symbol) AS etf_name,

    MONTH(p.month_start_date) AS calendar_month,

    CONCAT(
        LPAD(MONTH(p.month_start_date), 2, '0'),
        ' ',
        DATE_FORMAT(
            MAKE_DATE(
                2000,
                MONTH(p.month_start_date),
                1
            ),
            'MMM'
        )
    ) AS month_label,

    ROUND(
        AVG(p.monthly_return_pct),
        2
    ) AS avg_monthly_return_pct

FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance p

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON p.symbol = m.symbol

WHERE p.monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    p.symbol,
    m.etf_name,
    MONTH(p.month_start_date)

ORDER BY
    p.symbol,
    calendar_month;

datasets.name: 8386a00d
queryLines:
WITH latest_market_date AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(price_date) AS latest_date

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned

    WHERE adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

),

latest_prices AS (

    SELECT
        p.symbol,
        p.price_date AS end_date,
        p.adjusted_closing_price AS ending_price

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned p

    CROSS JOIN latest_market_date l

    WHERE p.adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL
      AND p.price_date <= l.latest_date

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.symbol
        ORDER BY p.price_date DESC
    ) = 1

),

starting_prices AS (

    SELECT
        p.symbol,
        p.price_date AS start_date,
        p.adjusted_closing_price AS starting_price

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned p

    CROSS JOIN latest_market_date l

    WHERE p.adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

      -- Thirty calendar days before the latest market date.
      -- The latest available trading date on or before that
      -- target date is selected.
      AND p.price_date <= DATE_SUB(l.latest_date, 30)

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.symbol
        ORDER BY p.price_date DESC
    ) = 1

),

rolling_returns AS (

    SELECT
        e.symbol,
        s.start_date,
        e.end_date,

        ROUND(
            100 * (
                e.ending_price
                / NULLIF(s.starting_price, 0)
                - 1
            ),
            2
        ) AS return_30d_pct

    FROM latest_prices e

    INNER JOIN starting_prices s
        ON e.symbol = s.symbol

),

market_statistics AS (

    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS etfs_tracked,

        ROUND(
            AVG(return_30d_pct),
            2
        ) AS avg_30d_return_pct,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * AVG(
                CASE
                    WHEN return_30d_pct > 0 THEN 1.0
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ),
            1
        ) AS positive_etf_ratio_pct

    FROM rolling_returns

),

best_etf AS (

    SELECT
        r.symbol AS best_symbol,
        COALESCE(m.etf_name, r.symbol) AS best_etf_name,
        r.return_30d_pct AS best_30d_return_pct

    FROM rolling_returns r

    LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
        ON r.symbol = m.symbol

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            r.return_30d_pct DESC,
            r.symbol
    ) = 1

),

worst_etf AS (

    SELECT
        r.symbol AS worst_symbol,
        COALESCE(m.etf_name, r.symbol) AS worst_etf_name,
        r.return_30d_pct AS worst_30d_return_pct

    FROM rolling_returns r

    LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
        ON r.symbol = m.symbol

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            r.return_30d_pct ASC,
            r.symbol
    ) = 1

),

reporting_period AS (

    SELECT
        MIN(start_date) AS period_start_date,
        MAX(end_date) AS latest_price_date

    FROM rolling_returns

)

SELECT
    p.period_start_date,
    p.latest_price_date,

    DATE_FORMAT(
        p.latest_price_date,
        'MMMM d, yyyy'
    ) AS latest_price_date_label,

    CONCAT(
        'Rolling 30-Day Market Snapshot | Prices updated through ',
        DATE_FORMAT(p.latest_price_date, 'MMMM d, yyyy'),
        ' | ',
        ms.etfs_tracked,
        ' ETFs tracked'
    ) AS overview_header_label,

    ms.etfs_tracked,
    ms.avg_30d_return_pct,
    ms.positive_etf_ratio_pct,

    b.best_symbol,
    b.best_etf_name,
    b.best_30d_return_pct,

    w.worst_symbol,
    w.worst_etf_name,
    w.worst_30d_return_pct,

    CONCAT(
    b.best_etf_name,
    ' (',
    CAST(b.best_30d_return_pct AS STRING),
    '%)'
) AS best_performer_label,

CONCAT(
    w.worst_etf_name,
    ' (',
    CAST(w.worst_30d_return_pct AS STRING),
    '%)'
) AS worst_performer_label,

    1 AS header_display_value

FROM market_statistics ms

CROSS JOIN best_etf b
CROSS JOIN worst_etf w
CROSS JOIN reporting_period p;

SELECT *

    ('6M', 5),
    ('YTD', 6),

datasets.name: f40a0bc2
queryLines:
WITH parameter_value AS (

    SELECT UPPER(:time_horizon) AS time_horizon

),

latest_market_date AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(price_date) AS latest_date

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned

    WHERE adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

),

ranked_daily_prices AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        price_date,
        adjusted_closing_price,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol
            ORDER BY price_date DESC
        ) AS recency_rank

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned

    WHERE adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

),

period_configuration AS (

    SELECT
        p.time_horizon,
        l.latest_date,

        CASE p.time_horizon
            WHEN '1M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -1)
            WHEN '3M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -3)
            WHEN '6M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -6)

            WHEN 'YTD' THEN CAST(
                DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', l.latest_date)
                AS DATE
            )

            WHEN '1Y' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -12)
            WHEN '3Y' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -36)
            WHEN '5Y' THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -60)
            WHEN 'MAX' THEN DATE '1900-01-01'
        END AS period_start_date

    FROM parameter_value p

    CROSS JOIN latest_market_date l

),

selected_prices AS (

    SELECT
        d.symbol,
        d.price_date,
        d.adjusted_closing_price,
        c.time_horizon

    FROM ranked_daily_prices d

    CROSS JOIN period_configuration c

    WHERE d.price_date <= c.latest_date

      AND (
            (
                c.time_horizon = '1D'
                AND d.recency_rank <= 2
            )

            OR

            (
                c.time_horizon = '1W'
                AND d.recency_rank <= 6
            )

            OR

            (
                c.time_horizon NOT IN ('1D', '1W')
                AND d.price_date >= c.period_start_date
            )
      )

),

performance_window AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        time_horizon,

        FIRST_VALUE(price_date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
            ORDER BY price_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                     AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS period_start_month,

        LAST_VALUE(price_date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
            ORDER BY price_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                     AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS period_end_month,

        FIRST_VALUE(adjusted_closing_price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
            ORDER BY price_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                     AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS starting_price,

        LAST_VALUE(adjusted_closing_price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
            ORDER BY price_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                     AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS ending_price,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
        ) AS price_observations,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, time_horizon
            ORDER BY price_date DESC
        ) AS final_row_number

    FROM selected_prices

),

period_performance AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        time_horizon,
        period_start_month,
        period_end_month,
        price_observations,

        ROUND(
            100 * (
                ending_price
                / NULLIF(starting_price, 0)
                - 1
            ),
            2
        ) AS period_return_pct

    FROM performance_window

    WHERE final_row_number = 1

)

SELECT
    p.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, p.symbol) AS etf_name,
    m.asset_class,
    m.region,
    m.category,

    p.time_horizon,
    p.period_start_month,
    p.period_end_month,

    CASE p.time_horizon
        WHEN '1D' THEN 1
        WHEN '1W' THEN 5
        WHEN '1M' THEN 1
        WHEN '3M' THEN 3
        WHEN '6M' THEN 6
        WHEN 'YTD' THEN MONTH(p.period_end_month)
        WHEN '1Y' THEN 12
        WHEN '3Y' THEN 36
        WHEN '5Y' THEN 60
        WHEN 'MAX' THEN NULL
    END AS months_available,

    CASE p.time_horizon
        WHEN '1D' THEN 1
        WHEN '1W' THEN 5
        WHEN '1M' THEN 1
        WHEN '3M' THEN 3
        WHEN '6M' THEN 6
        WHEN 'YTD' THEN MONTH(p.period_end_month)
        WHEN '1Y' THEN 12
        WHEN '3Y' THEN 36
        WHEN '5Y' THEN 60
        WHEN 'MAX' THEN NULL
    END AS expected_months,

    p.price_observations,
    p.period_return_pct,

    CASE
        WHEN p.period_return_pct >= 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS return_direction

FROM period_performance p

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON p.symbol = m.symbol

ORDER BY
    p.period_return_pct DESC,
    p.symbol;

datasets.name: 53aaa356
queryLines:
WITH parameter_value AS (

    SELECT UPPER(:time_horizon) AS time_horizon

),

latest_market_date AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(price_date) AS latest_date

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned

    WHERE adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

),

ranked_daily_prices AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        price_date,
        adjusted_closing_price,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol
            ORDER BY price_date DESC
        ) AS recency_rank

    FROM silver.etf_prices_cleaned

    WHERE adjusted_closing_price IS NOT NULL

),

period_configuration AS (

    SELECT
        p.time_horizon,
        l.latest_date,

        CASE p.time_horizon
            WHEN '1M'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -1)

            WHEN '3M'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -3)

            WHEN '6M'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -6)

            WHEN 'YTD'
                THEN CAST(
                    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', l.latest_date)
                    AS DATE
                )

            WHEN '1Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -12)

            WHEN '3Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -36)

            WHEN '5Y'
                THEN ADD_MONTHS(l.latest_date, -60)

            WHEN 'MAX'
                THEN DATE '1900-01-01'
        END AS period_start_date

    FROM parameter_value p

    CROSS JOIN latest_market_date l

),

selected_prices AS (

    SELECT
        d.symbol,
        d.price_date,
        d.adjusted_closing_price,
        c.time_horizon

    FROM ranked_daily_prices d

    CROSS JOIN period_configuration c

    WHERE d.price_date <= c.latest_date

      AND (
            (
                c.time_horizon = '1D'
                AND d.recency_rank <= 2
            )

            OR

            (
                c.time_horizon = '1W'
                AND d.recency_rank <= 6
            )

            OR

            (
                c.time_horizon NOT IN ('1D', '1W')
                AND d.price_date >= c.period_start_date
            )
      )

),

normalized_prices AS (

    SELECT
        symbol,
        price_date,
        time_horizon,

        ROUND(
            100.0
            * adjusted_closing_price
            / NULLIF(
                FIRST_VALUE(adjusted_closing_price) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY symbol
                    ORDER BY price_date
                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                             AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
                ),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS normalized_value

    FROM selected_prices

)

SELECT
    n.symbol,
    COALESCE(m.etf_name, n.symbol) AS etf_name,

    -- Existing name retained so the chart configuration does not break
    n.price_date AS month_start_date,

    n.time_horizon,
    n.normalized_value

FROM normalized_prices n

LEFT JOIN reference.etf_metadata m
    ON n.symbol = m.symbol

ORDER BY
    n.symbol,
    n.price_date;

datasets.name: 6d697d1c
queryLines:
WITH all_available_returns AS (

    SELECT
        month_start_date,
        MONTH(month_start_date) AS calendar_month,
        monthly_return_pct

    FROM gold.etf_month_by_month_performance

    WHERE monthly_return_pct IS NOT NULL

),

monthly_statistics AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,

        DATE_FORMAT(
            MAKE_DATE(2000, calendar_month, 1),
            'MMMM'
        ) AS month_name,

        ROUND(
            AVG(monthly_return_pct),
            2
        ) AS avg_return_pct,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * AVG(
                CASE
                    WHEN monthly_return_pct > 0 THEN 1.0
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ),
            1
        ) AS positive_ratio_pct,

        COUNT(*) AS observations

    FROM all_available_returns

    GROUP BY calendar_month

),

strongest_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            avg_return_pct DESC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

weakest_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            avg_return_pct ASC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

most_consistent_month AS (

    SELECT
        calendar_month,
        month_name,
        avg_return_pct,
        positive_ratio_pct,
        observations

    FROM monthly_statistics

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            positive_ratio_pct DESC,
            avg_return_pct DESC,
            calendar_month
    ) = 1

),

coverage AS (

    SELECT
        MIN(month_start_date) AS first_month,
        MAX(month_start_date) AS latest_month

    FROM all_available_returns

)

SELECT
    s.month_name AS strongest_month,
    s.avg_return_pct AS strongest_return_pct,
    s.positive_ratio_pct AS strongest_month_positive_ratio_pct,

    w.month_name AS weakest_month,
    w.avg_return_pct AS weakest_return_pct,
    w.positive_ratio_pct AS weakest_month_positive_ratio_pct,

    c.month_name AS consistent_month,
    c.positive_ratio_pct AS consistent_positive_ratio_pct,
    c.avg_return_pct AS consistent_month_avg_return_pct,

    DATE_FORMAT(v.first_month, 'MMM yyyy') AS first_month_label,
    DATE_FORMAT(v.latest_month, 'MMM yyyy') AS latest_month_label,

    CASE
        WHEN v.latest_month =
             CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AS DATE)
        THEN 'Includes current month-to-date data'
        ELSE 'Completed months only'
    END AS data_scope_label

FROM strongest_month s

CROSS JOIN weakest_month w
CROSS JOIN most_consistent_month c
CROSS JOIN coverage v;
